args.evidence: fct_orders.region_name nulls (1892) come from left join to dim_customers where customer_key missing (missing_cust=1892). dim_customers has fewer customers (1319) than stg_customers (1500) and orders reference missing customers. Thus source orders contain customer_key values not present in source customers, causing null region_name. No code error in models.
